name: wpab/mcp-kit
description: Lets any WPAB WooCommerce plugin expose its own MCP endpoint on top of WordPress's Abilities API and wordpress/mcp-adapter.

scripts.lint:74: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/app -w /app php:7.4-cli sh -c 'for f in src/*.php scoper.inc.php examples/config/mcp.php; do php -l "$f" >/dev/null || exit 1; done; echo ok'

scripts-descriptions.lint: php -l across the kit's own sources.

scripts-descriptions.compat: Static check against the PHP floor composer.json declares.
scripts-descriptions.test: The regression suite. Point it at a WordPress with WP_PATH and WP_URL; add --destructive against a throwaway install.
